nodes.name: zellij.kdl
nodes.summary: Zellij terminal multiplexer workspace layout for the OrdeloAgent project, defining named tabs, pane splits, status/tab-bar plugins, and multiple swap layouts (vertical, horizontal, stacked) for efficient multi-pane development sessions.
nodes.languageNotes: KDL (KDL Document Language) format used by Zellij; the layout includes a self-updating pane that dumps the current layout back to this file via `zellij action dump-layout`.
